description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for web search provider configuration, cache management, date normalization, and filtering support, specific to the openclaw project.

methods.name: resolveSearchTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Resolves the timeout seconds for a search configuration, defaulting if not specified.

methods.name: resolveSearchCacheTtlMs
methods.description: Resolves the cache TTL in milliseconds for a search configuration.

methods.name: resolveSearchCount
methods.description: Parses and clamps a search count value within allowed limits.

methods.name: readConfiguredSecretString
methods.description: Normalizes and reads a secret string from a value and path.

methods.name: readProviderEnvValue
methods.description: Reads the first set environment variable value from a list.

methods.name: withTrustedWebSearchEndpoint
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to a trusted web search endpoint with a response handler.

methods.name: postTrustedWebToolsJson
methods.description: Posts JSON data to a trusted web tools API and parses the response.

methods.name: throwWebSearchApiError
methods.description: Throws an error with details from a failed web search API response.

methods.name: resolveSiteName
methods.description: Extracts hostname from a URL string.

methods.name: isoToPerplexityDate
methods.description: Converts ISO date string to Perplexity date format.

methods.name: normalizeToIsoDate
methods.description: Normalizes various date string formats to ISO date format.

methods.name: parseIsoDateRange
methods.description: Parses and validates date range inputs, returning errors if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeFreshness
methods.description: Normalizes freshness or recency values based on provider.

methods.name: readCachedSearchPayload
methods.description: Reads cached search payload from cache.

methods.name: buildSearchCacheKey
methods.description: Builds a cache key string from parts.

methods.name: writeCachedSearchPayload
methods.description: Writes a payload to cache with TTL.

methods.name: buildUnsupportedSearchFilterResponse
methods.description: Builds an error response for unsupported search filters.
